messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: tokenization/preproc pipeline causing user-visible tail latency. p99 = 9.4s (SLO 5s). Streaming stalls observed. Auto-page created #INC-2026-214.

Sam Carter: oncall here, paging runtime + ml infra. seeing spike on dashboards, routing to you @Priya @Leo.

Priya Nair: looking. which service is tripping? tokenizer or router?

Sam Carter: graphs show steep queue growth at preproc-tokenizer (preproc-tokenizer-prod). p95 ~1.3s, p99 ~9.4s, error rate flat. streaming sessions show stalled 'awaiting tokens' for 4-10s.

Leo Zhang: fetching logs now. running kubectl get pods -n inference preproc-tokenizer-prod -o wide
Leo Zhang: syslogs: "template_expand: regex heavy path took 1200ms on some requests" repeated. also many requests hitting JSON-mode path.

Priya Nair: that matches recent deploy? I see a config flip this morning that enabled "json-mode: strict_parsing" for tool-schema expansion (rev f2c9). Could be expensive for long prompt templates.

Sam Carter: rolling back that config sounds low-risk. can we toggle it to lenient?

Priya Nair: I'll flip to lenient and restart preproc replicas one at a time. command: `kubectl patch cm preproc-config -n inference -p '{"data":{"json_mode":"lenient"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/preproc-tokenizer-prod`

Marta López: CS reports 2 enterprise customers (enterprise-corp-42, finapp-alpha) saw streaming stalls; some users got blank responses. flagged on CS queue.

ops-oncall: increasing horizontal pod autoscaler minReplicas from 3 -> 6 as temporary burst: `kubectl patch hpa preproc-tokenizer-prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`

Priya Nair: done patch to config and restarted pods. watching metrics.

Sam Carter: initial effect?

Priya Nair: p95 now ~0.9s, p99 dropped to ~3.1s (best-effort). streaming stalls reduced but not gone. still seeing a tail with some requests 6-8s.

Leo Zhang: deeper: the expensive path is prompt template expansion combined with tool-schema validation using recursive regex. Stack traces show `TemplateExpander.expand()` spending 65-80% CPU on those pods.

Priya Nair: can we short-circuit expensive validation for streaming requests? maybe skip full schema coercion for streaming and fall back to fast-validate.

Sam Carter: mitigate plan: 1) enable lenient JSON-mode (done) 2) increase HPA min (done) 3) add fast-validate hotfix (dev path) 4) route streaming requests to dedicated pool without heavy validation (if possible).

Priya Nair: implementing fast-validate patch now — small code change to bypass deep regex on known templates. will deploy to canary (preproc-tokenizer-canary).

Leo Zhang: while patch deploys, I'll open temporary routing rule to send streaming traffic to tokenizer-lite variant: set route header `X-Preproc-Mode: fast` for streaming endpoints. patching gateway config.

Marta López: notifying affected customers: message drafted and sent to enterprise-corp-42: "We've identified a tokenizer preproc regression causing increased tail latency; mitigation underway, expected improvement within 30–45m."

inc-bot: Timeline note: alert created 1793456789. severity P1.

Priya Nair: canary looks good — p99 on canary pods ~1.8s for same test vector. promoting patch to prod in 2 batches.

Sam Carter: rolling promote. doing batch 1 (50% of pods). monitor 5m.

Leo Zhang: gateway routing rule updated to prefer tokenizer-lite for streaming.

Priya Nair: after batch1, p99 back to 2.3s across prod, streaming stalls rare.

Sam Carter: continue with batch2.

Priya Nair: batch2 done. p95 0.8s, p99 2.1s. streaming stalls baseline now comparable to normal.

Marta López: CS updated customers. closing active support escalation for finapp-alpha.

Sam Carter: confirming SLO breach cleared? p99 < 5s sustained for 15m?

Leo Zhang: metrics show sustained p99=2.1s for 18m. marking incident mitigated.

inc-bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED. Please file postmortem and link to #incidents. Next steps: root cause analysis, revert risky regex-heavy validation, create kill-switch for heavy template parsing, add alert for preproc queue growth earlier.

Sam Carter: assigning follow-ups: 1) Priya -> implement config flag to disable deep regex per-route; 2) Leo -> add metric for template-expansion CPU ratio and preproc queue alarm; 3) DevEx -> add docs about recommended prompt template size/avoid complex tool schemas for streaming apps.

Priya Nair: will open PR for config flag + unit tests.

Leo Zhang: I'll add the alert and dashboard panel.

Marta López: I'll compile customer impact list and send to CS leads.

Sam Carter: Handoff: night oncall @ops-oncall, summary: incident triggered by json-mode strict parsing enabling deep regex on prompt template expansion; hotfix deployed to skip heavy validation for streaming, gateway routing to tokenizer-lite, scaled pods. p99 from 9.4s -> 2.1s. customers notified. full postmortem PR: #PM-2026-214.

ops-oncall: acknowledged, will watch the dashboards overnight. please ping if any regression. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: thanks team. will include benchmark of template expansion in PR.

Sam Carter: closing thread, moving to follow-up. :white_check_mark:
